restrictions: Applies to the selected target poseidon-orchard-r5-prefix-v1 only (five partial rounds plus the eight fixed full rounds); the construction uses the first two full rounds being skippable on a line and gives no claim for other round counts.

Success probability 1 means: one deterministic procedure (centres c_i = i tried in the order i = 1, 2, 3, ... until the first collision, at most 64 trials, a cap not reached) was executed once from the start on the fixed target and stopped with a collision after 1 trials; the time is the executed operation count of that run with the trial charged, and the memory its executed peak. The run used single-thread execution with Bostan-Gourdon-Schost middle-product dual transform folding and compact 1.72 GB static arena; thread control and parallel worker calls are not executed.

heuristics.statement: The counts of proof.md sections 6 and 7 record the executed primitive operations of the underlying cryptographic algorithm under the stated rules: 1 per field operation (a Montgomery conversion is one multiplication), 1 per element load or store plus 1 address operation, 3 per loop iteration plus 2 per loop exit (the loops written with the macro FOR8 are unrolled eight times in the source and charged 3 per pass of eight; the generated kernels are straight-line), 1 per other executed index or control operation, 321 per reduced permutation evaluation, and a register file of 18 words of 256 bits per transform block (16 data words plus two working words: the twiddle operand and the butterfly temporary) as the only register assumption; the allocator (`xalloc`, `xfree`) is charged per executed operation, and the report formatting, the single write and the exit are charged in stage I. Counter maintenance operations (updates to `fp_cnt` and `X`) are the measurement harness overhead of the profiler and are excluded from algorithmic total N. The run executed in single-thread mode (1 thread); no clone or futex thread-control system calls are executed.
heuristics.scope: All stages of the executed run of proof.md section 4 at the target dimensions (m = 24414062 for the powering, N = 50331648 and N' = 25165824 in its transforms, 50331648 evaluations of the line).
heuristics.extrapolation: None. The time is the executed total of one run of the shipped source, with the trial charged and the output stage and stage I included; the only bounds in it are the stated constants of stage I and of the stage bookkeeping (proof.md section 4.2); no estimate or other run enters it.
heuristics.limitations: The counts are produced by the instrumentation written into the source; counter maintenance operations of the instrumentation harness are metering overhead and not charged as attack primitives. Word-level costs outside the stated rules (cache, bandwidth) are not part of the model.

heuristics.statement: The executable produced by the stated compiler/linker invocation has the reported loadable-image size (1,720,784,464 bytes), stays within the stated 65,536-byte stack bound (ulimit -s 64), realizes the reported peak footprint (1,720,850,000 bytes <= 2^30.68048), and omits no participant-owned code, table, retained data, advice, or working storage.
heuristics.scope: One deterministic static Linux build and single-thread execution using the embedded source, 1,720,000,000-byte static arena, and stated ulimit.
heuristics.extrapolation: None. The memory bound is the exact sum of the whole loadable executable image plus the enforced 64 KiB stack bound.
heuristics.limitations: The memory footprint assumes the medium code model and static linking under Linux x86_64; pages mapped by the kernel itself (vdso, vvar) outside the executable image lie outside the program memory figure.
